label: Classroom occupant density and activity
definition: Pupils per m2 and physical activity level in the room which drive both CO2 and resuspended coarse particles

label: Bus cabin sealing and window position
definition: Whether bus windows are closed with AC on which raises self-pollution from the bus's own exhaust

label: Indoor evaporator coil fouling
definition: Dust deposition on the indoor cooling coil driven by indoor particle load and filter grade

label: Service station and depot benzene
definition: Evaporative benzene at bus depots and refuelling points
